      ITEM_SALES_SQL

      sqlStatement
      "SELECT EXTRACT(HOUR FROM time) AS hour,\nCOUNT(*) AS num_orders,\nCOUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE refund = TRUE) AS num_refunds,\nCOUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE payment_method = \'credit\') AS credit,\nCOUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE payment_method = \'debit\') AS debit,\nCOUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE payment_method = \'gift\') AS gift,\nCOUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE payment_method = \'mobile\') AS mobile,\nCOUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE payment_method = \'cash\') AS cash\nFROM sale\nWHERE time >= CURRENT_DATE AND time < CURRENT_DATE + INTERVAL \'1 day\'\nGROUP BY hour ORDER BY hour ASC;\n"

      private static final String
      PROFIT_SQL
      "WITH days AS ( SELECT d::date AS day FROM generate_series(CURRENT_DATE - 6, CURRENT_DATE, interval \'1 day\') d), revenue AS ( SELECT time::date AS day, COUNT(*) AS orders, SUM(sale_cost) AS revenue FROM sale WHERE NOT refund AND time::date >= CURRENT_DATE - 6 GROUP BY 1), recipe_cost AS ( SELECT mii.menu_item_id, SUM(inv.cost_per_unit) AS cost FROM menu_item_ingredient mii JOIN ingredient ing ON ing.id = mii.ingredient_id JOIN inventory inv ON inv.name = ing.name AND inv.type = \'ingredient\' GROUP BY mii.menu_item_id), ingredient_cost AS ( SELECT s.time::date AS day, SUM(si.quantity * rc.cost) AS cost FROM sale s JOIN sale_item si ON si.sale_id = s.id JOIN recipe_cost rc ON rc.menu_item_id = si.menu_item_id WHERE NOT s.refund AND s.time::date >= CURRENT_DATE - 6 GROUP BY 1) SELECT d.day, COALESCE(r.orders, 0) AS orders, COALESCE(r.revenue, 0) AS revenue, COALESCE(c.cost, 0) AS ingredient_cost, COALESCE(r.revenue, 0) - COALESCE(c.cost, 0) AS profit FROM days d LEFT JOIN revenue r ON r.day = d.day LEFT JOIN ingredient_cost c ON c.day = d.day ORDER BY d.day"
